meta.toolchain: forge Version: 1.5.1-v1.5.1; solc 0.8.28, optimizer 1e6 runs, evm cancun; anvil --hardfork prague
meta.poolParameters: per pool: baseDecimals, quoteDecimals, priceScale = PRICE_SCALE(), kScale = K_SCALE(); MAX_TTL 600 s, MAX_TTL_BLOCKS 5000; chain starts at block 58500000
meta.semantics: snapshot = public views at one pinned block (counters() included); quotes = quoteDetailed at that block (quoteBlockNumber, quoteTimestamp); nextQuotes = the same amounts at the next, empty block (nextBlockNumber, nextTimestamp); error = revert selector name or null; sequence = real transactions after that, in mining order: type 'swap' (fill or revert at blockNumber/timestamp) or type 'update' (stateWord = the word the pool stored); several steps can share a block
